definition: Estimates Mangrove Drone Nurseries readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a nursery hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Mangrove Drone Nurseries operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where propagule drones monitoring, nursery logistics redundancy, or planting windows maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mangrove Drone Nurseries Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mangrove Drone Nurseries: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mangrove Drone Nurseries — nurseries growing mangroves by drone.

Phase 1 — Prove (propagule drones): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (nursery logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (planting windows): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (growth tracking): nursery hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and tropics-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
